description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthClientDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides data access methods for managing OAuth client entities, including saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuth client records, in addition to fetching clients by ID or client ID.

classes.name: OAuthClientDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for OAuthClient entities, providing CRUD operations and query functionalities specific to OAuth clients.

methods.name: saveOAuthClient
methods.description: Persists an OAuthClient entity into the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getOAuthClientList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of OAuthClient entities based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Returns the count of OAuthClient entities matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Creates and configures a QueryBuilderWrapper for OAuthClient queries based on search filters.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthClient entity by its clientId.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Deletes multiple OAuthClient entities by their IDs.
